sintoma: NOC-2201: PC da contabilidade não alcança servidores da VLAN 40. Cabo e NIC ok em outro ponto.
cli_output:
SW-ACC# show interfaces Gi1/0/18 status
Port      Name           Status       Vlan  Duplex  Speed Type
Gi1/0/18  PC-CONTAB      connected    1     a-full  a-1000 10/100/1000BaseTX

SW-ACC# show run interface Gi1/0/18
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/18
 description PC-CONTAB
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 1
 spanning-tree portfast

SW-ACC# show vlan brief | include 40|1
1    default                          active    Gi1/0/18, ...
40   USERS-ACC                        active

PC: ipconfig → 10.1.1.50/24 (VLAN1 lab range) — expected 10.40.0.0/24
alternativas: Problema de PoE fault no PC
Corrigir switchport access vlan 40 e verificar show interfaces status (Vlan 40)
Configurar trunk allowed vlan 1-4094 no PC
Remover PortFast causa a VLAN 40
explicacao_profunda: Status e running-config mostram access vlan 1; o desenho é VLAN 40. Ajuste access vlan 40. PoE não alimenta PC típico; trunk no endpoint e remover PortFast não movem a VLAN de dados.

sintoma: NOC-2202: PC atrás do telefone navega; telefone não registra no call control. PoE delivering.
cli_output:
SW-ACC# show run interface Gi1/0/7
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/7
 description MESA-12-PHONE
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 40
 spanning-tree portfast
 (no switchport voice vlan)

SW-ACC# show power inline Gi1/0/7
Interface Admin  Oper       Power   Device              Class Max
          State  State      (Watts)
--------- ------ ---------- ------- ------------------- ----- ----
Gi1/0/7   auto   on         6.3     Ieee PD             2     30.0
Interface AdminPowerMax AdminConsumption
          (Watts)       (Watts)
--------- ------------- ----------------
Gi1/0/7   30.0          6.3

SW-ACC# show interfaces Gi1/0/7 switchport | include Access|Voice|Mode
Administrative Mode: static access
Access Mode VLAN: 40 (USERS)
Voice VLAN: none

Phone log: registering on data VLAN only / no voice subnet
alternativas: Aumentar a largura do Port-channel do core
Desligar PoE (já delivering) para forçar registro
Adicionar switchport voice vlan (ex. 50) — access 40 só cobre o PC; voz ausente
Mudar mode para trunk native 40 sem voice
explicacao_profunda: PoE ok e Voice VLAN: none com PC na 40 explicam voz falha e dados ok. Configure voice vlan. Não desligue PoE que está delivering; trunk nativo não substitui o desenho voice vlan de mesa.

sintoma: NOC-2203: AP novo não acende LEDs; sem discovery no WLC. Cabo recém-passado.
cli_output:
SW-ACC# show interfaces Gi1/0/24 status
Port      Name        Status       Vlan  Duplex Speed Type
Gi1/0/24  AP-SALA-3   notconnect   15    auto   auto  10/100/1000BaseTX

SW-ACC# show power inline Gi1/0/24
Interface Admin  Oper       Power   Device   Class Max
Gi1/0/24  auto   off        0.0     n/a      n/a   30.0
Oper State: off / absent

SW-ACC# show run interface Gi1/0/24
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/24
 description AP-SALA-3
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 15
 spanning-tree portfast
 no shutdown

Tech: reseated same cable → still notconnect; spare known-good PoE cable → still off
alternativas: Falta de voice vlan 15 no AP
OSPF missing on access switch
SSID open obrigatório antes do link
Sem link/PoE (notconnect, power off/absent) — cabo/PD/porta PoE antes de culpar WLC
explicacao_profunda: notconnect e power off/absent mostram que L1/PoE não estabeleceram. VLAN 15 e PortFast já estão; sem link o WLC não descobre o AP. Troque cabo/teste outra porta PoE/PD. Voice e OSPF não acendem o AP.

sintoma: NOC-2204: câmera IoT não obtém IP na VLAN 80; às vezes 'link estranho'. Config encontrada:
cli_output:
SW-ACC# show run interface Gi1/0/33
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/33
 description CAM-PORTAO
 switchport trunk encapsulation dot1q
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 80
 spanning-tree portfast trunk

SW-ACC# show interfaces Gi1/0/33 switchport | include Mode|Access|Trunking
Administrative Mode: trunk
Operational Mode: trunk
Access Mode VLAN: 1 (default)
Trunking Native Mode VLAN: 1 (default)

SW-ACC# show interfaces Gi1/0/33 status
Port      Name        Status    Vlan  Duplex Speed
Gi1/0/33  CAM-PORTAO  connected trunk a-full a-1000

Camera expects untagged single VLAN 80 access port
alternativas: Manter trunk e adicionar voice vlan 80
Remover a câmera da rede e usar Wi-Fi guest
Alterar para switchport mode access e switchport access vlan 80 (endpoint IoT)
Configurar no switchport ip address 80 na câmera
explicacao_profunda: Câmera/IoT deve ser access na VLAN 80, não trunk. Operational trunk com native 1 explica IP errado/ausente. Corrija mode access + access vlan 80. Voice e IP na L2 port do switch não são o fix.

sintoma: NOC-2205: PCs em mesas novas demoram ~40s para pegar DHCP; portas access recém-criadas sem PortFast. Uma porta de sala de reunião vazia ficou up por engano.
cli_output:
SW-ACC# show run interface Gi1/0/40
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/40
 description PC-MESA-NOVA
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 40
 (no spanning-tree portfast)
 no shutdown

SW-ACC# show spanning-tree interface Gi1/0/40
Vlan Role Sts Cost  Prio.Nbr Type
---- ---- --- ----- -------- ----
VLAN0040 Desg LRN 19    128.40  P2p
(transitioning; not yet FWD at boot capture)

SW-ACC# show run interface Gi1/0/48
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/48
 description EMPTY-MEETING
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 40
 no shutdown

SW-ACC# show interfaces Gi1/0/48 status
Gi1/0/48  EMPTY-MEETING  notconnect  40  auto  auto
alternativas: Habilitar spanning-tree portfast nas access de usuário e shutdown na porta ociosa Gi1/0/48
Converter todas as mesas para trunk
Desabilitar DHCP na VLAN 40
Remover access vlan e usar só native trunk
explicacao_profunda: Learning sem PortFast atrasa o forwarding e o DHCP no boot. Portas vazias devem ficar em shutdown. Edge: PortFast nas mesas + shutdown na 48. Trunk em massa e matar DHCP pioram o serviço.
